paperTitle: LABORAL: A Transformational Game for Hand Stretching Exercises to Prevent Occupational Diseases
centralContribution: This work presents LABORAL, a transformational game designed to facilitate hand stretching exercises using gesture-interactions, aiming to prevent occupational diseases such as Repetitive Strain Injury (RSI) and Work-Related Musculoskeletal Disorder (WMSD) in individuals, particularly IT professionals, who perform repetitive movements using computers. The game was developed in Unity using the Leap Motion sensor to provide an engaging and educational platform for promoting upper limb health and behavioral transformation.
